title: Compatibility of assembled local model with transport
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E$ a sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $U\to T$ an etale morphism (not necessarily surjective). Let $Q$ be a finite etale $U$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] and let $e$ identify the restriction of $E$ to the localized site at $U$ with the lifted Yoneda presheaf of $Q$ precomposed with the localized-site equivalence. There exists a scheme descent datum $d$ [def-pd-descent-datum] on $Q$ relative to $U\to T$ such that, for every etale $W\to T$, lifts $a,b:W\to U$ and section $s\in E(W)$, $d$ transports the $Q$-point corresponding under $e$ to $(W,a,s)$ to the $Q$-point corresponding under $e$ to $(W,b,s)$. No covering hypothesis or assembly of Q is needed.

proof.text: Over H=U times_T U, pull back Q along both projections. Each pullback represents the restriction of E to H via the given isomorphism e and the corresponding projection. This identification is natural in etale objects over H by naturality of e and the pullback universal property. Yoneda full faithfulness gives the unique scheme comparison isomorphism over H.

Over U times_T U times_T U the comparisons all identify the same section of E. Composing the first two comparisons therefore gives the third. Yoneda faithfulness proves the cocycle equality of scheme morphisms. Pullback along the diagonal similarly gives the identity comparison.

For any scheme W and lifts a,b with equal composite to T, base change the comparison along (a,b):W to H, and apply it to points of Q over a. Pullback functoriality proves naturality in arbitrary W. The diagonal and cocycle equalities give transport_self and transport_transport, yielding a scheme descent datum. It is legitimate to construct the comparison on the small site: H and the pullback representatives are etale over the indicated bases. The later base change to W does not evaluate E on W unless W is etale over T.

For an etale W over T, the comparison is defined under the two representation isomorphisms to identify the same section s of E(W). Evaluating its transport on the point e_a(s) therefore gives e_b(s), exactly the displayed underlying scheme-map equality. Empty objects satisfy this equation by their unique sections.

mathlib_searches.query: Local finite etale representatives of a sheaf assemble over a coproduct and induce a descent datum compatible with sections
An etale scheme representing restriction of a sheaf on the small etale site carries a descent datum compatible with sections
mathlib_searches.results: Pseudofunctor.isEquivalence_toDescentData, Scheme.Etale.forget, Scheme.smallEtaleTopology and GlueData.sheafValGluedMk; supporting interfaces only, no theorem with this localized small-site representation input.
Scheme.Etale, Etale.forgetFullyFaithful and finite-limit instances; no assembly or compatible descent theorem.

from.place: Yoneda comparison and transport for a fixed local representation

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLocalModels_descentDatum_compatibility
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (U : T.Etale)
    (Q : U.left.FiniteEtale)
    (e : (E.over U).obj ≅ (Etale.overToEtale U).op ⋙
      uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj Q.obj) :
    ∃ d : Over.DescentDatum U.hom (Over.mk Q.obj.hom),
      ∀ (W : T.Etale) (a b : W ⟶ U) (s : E.obj.obj (op W)),
        (d.transport a.left b.left
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.w a).trans (MorphismProperty.Over.w b).symm)
          (Over.homMk ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk a))) s).down.left
            (MorphismProperty.Over.w ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk a))) s).down))).left =
          ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk b))) s).down.left
